newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Ansett Australia considers airfare hikes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Ansett Australia considers airfare hikes.

text.p: Ansett Australia said on Tuesday it was considering raising its passenger airfares to compensate for higher fuel costs but had yet to make a decision.
"We're still analysing what impact higher fuel costs have on our business. Obviously fuel costs do make up a sizeable part of our overall operating costs," a spokesman said.
Ansett is a member of the International Air Transport Association which announced in Geneva last week that its 251 member airlines planned to raise passenger fares three percent.
The Australian newspaper reported on Tuesday that Qantas Airways Ltd, Ansett's major domestic competitor, planned to increase its fares by 2.5 percent from Wednesday.
A Qantas spokesman was unavailable for comment.
The newsapaper said Ansett would follow Qantas and increase its fares as well.
The Ansett spokesman said he could not say when a decision would be made.
